versions.changelog:
No code or functional changes in this version.

- Documentation updated with concise setup instructions for local use.
- Clarified that core deadline tracking works from local client files without external credentials.
- Added details on optional environment variables for Slack, SMS, email, and calendar alert integrations.
- Explained that unconfigured alert channels are skipped without errors.
- No changes to CLI commands or monitoring capabilities.

Initial release — CLI tool for real-time monitoring of Greek tax and compliance deadlines.

- Provides command-line monitoring of tax and social security deadlines via AADE and EFKA APIs (with scraping where APIs are unavailable).
- Features proactive, automated alerts for upcoming deadlines, system changes, and rate updates.
- Supports municipal tax, license, and permit tracking for Greek businesses and property owners.
- Includes a flexible CLI interface with quick status checks, scheduling, alert management, and data export (JSON, CSV, calendar).
- Offers integration with email, Slack/Teams, and external systems for automated notifications and workflow embedding.
- Requires jq tool and OPENCLAW_DATA_DIR environment variable for operation.
